prompt_html: True or false: For a short strangle, TWS knows that selling a call requires the sale of a lower strike put at the same expiration. Hence, both legs display in red.
True or false: An investor expecting an underlying share price to remain confined within a specific range might enter a short strangle strategy using options.
True or false: A short straddle involves the sale of an out-the-money call and an out-the-money put with the same expiration.
True or false: An investor expecting an underlying share price to remain confined within a specific range might enter a short straddle strategy using options.
True or false: A short straddle options strategy involves writing or selling an equal number of call and put options at the same strike price using the same expiration month.
True or false: A short strangle options strategy involves writing or selling an equal number of call and put options at the different strike prices using the same expiration month.
